title: 18.102 Introduction to Functional Analysis
authors: Richard Melrose (2020 lecture notes, followed by the course)
description: Undergraduate functional analysis: normed spaces, completeness, functionals, Hahn–Banach, duality, operators; Lebesgue measure and integration, L^p spaces; Hilbert spaces; compact and self-adjoint operators; the spectral theorem. Full set of lecture videos, per-lecture notes, problem sets and exams.
rightsNotes: Content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by MIT OpenCourseWare; attribution and share-alike are required and commercial use is excluded. Corniversity is private and non-commercial.

Importing the lecture-notes PDFs for personal study and citation is within the licence; the course's problem sets are linked, not copied, and any Corniversity exercise derived from them is labelled adapted_with_attribution.
The notes follow Richard Melrose's 2020 notes together with notes taken by an MIT student in the 2021 class, as stated on the syllabus page; the notes page itself names no author.
